maya singh: hey all — quick onboarding Q. who do I ping for prod DB read access, and who should I cc if something I do touches infra? trying to finish first-day checklist.
Ben Liu: @maya singh for prod DB reads ping me or @Chris (IT). for any schema or perf concerns loop in @Ryan Tran.
maya singh: thanks @Ben. do I need a ticket for DB read-only?
Ben Liu: yep — IT prefers a ticket so we can track approvals. Chris can share the template.
Chris (IT): filing a ticket is easiest. short format: `service: prod-db
reason: read access for feature X
duration: 6 months (or permanent)` — paste that in the IT portal and tag `access-review`.
maya singh: awesome — any escalation path if a deploy is blocked because of my change? who owns that?
Ryan Tran: if deploy is blocked by infra (e.g., capacity, maintenance), ping `#eng-oncall` and DM me. if it's app-level rollback, ping the owning product eng lead (Samira for Payments).
Samira Khan: correct — Payments owns runtime changes in prod. CC me and `#release-war-room` for anything rollout-related.
maya singh: got it. who does the oncall handoff usually go to when someone's OOO?
oncall-bot: Oncall schedule: week of Mar 14 — Ryan Tran (primary), Ben Liu (secondary). Use `/oncall handoff @user` 24h before shift.
Ben Liu: if you're taking over midweek, DM the current oncall and post a short handoff note in `#eng-oncall` with incidents to watch.
maya singh: any docs covering who owns third-party access (Salesforce, Looker)? I was asked to get Looker reports access.
Chris (IT): Salesforce ownership: Sales infra owns account provisioning; create ticket with `salesforce-access` tag. Looker: analytics team owns grants — tag @Samira for Payments dashboards, or `#analytics` for broader grants.
maya singh: thanks — last Q: if I hit a permission error on CI that blocks merges, is that an oncall thing or a devops ticket?
Ryan Tran: CI auth failures -> first ping `#eng-infra` and `#eng-oncall` if it impacts prod deploys. If it's a flaky job, open a devops issue and cc me.
maya singh: perfect, really helpful. I'll open the tickets and link them here. :party-parrot:
Samira Khan: welcome again! Ping any of us for quick context. :wave:
Ben Liu: also adding a short checklist you can copy into tickets:

```
- Reason for access + example commands
- Expected duration
- Services that will be touched
- Owner to notify on deploy (team + person)
```

maya singh: copying that — thanks everyone :)
Chris (IT): FYI, once ticket's in I can expedite for new hires if HR verifies start date.
maya singh: I'll attach the HR email. thanks!
Ben Liu: thumbs up. one more: if you need emergency escalation after hours, call the oncall pager number and then DM the oncall. details in `#eng-oncall` pinned message.
maya singh: noted. thanks all — closing this thread after I link tickets.
thread_text_snippet: who do I ping for prod DB read access and who to cc if something touches infra
